divisions.name: Division II
divisions.level: Mid to lower varsity and high-level JV

divisions.name: Division IV
divisions.level: Lower JV, C-teams and freshman teams

sections.title: Match format
items: All matches are best 2 of 3. Sets 1 and 2 go to 25 (cap at 27). A deciding third set goes to 15 (cap at 17).
Every team is guaranteed a minimum of 5 matches. We add more matches when registration numbers allow.
Warm-ups start at 7:30am. First matches start at 8:00am.
Each team gets two 30-second timeouts per set.
Teams bring their own warm-up balls and ball carts.

sections.title: Warm-ups
items: First two rounds of each wave: 2-4-4. 2 minutes shared, 4 minutes serving team, 4 minutes receiving team.
All later rounds: 1-2-2. 1 minute shared, 2 minutes serving team, 2 minutes receiving team.
Serving happens during each team's own court time, not during shared time.
Both teams may agree to waive warm-ups and start play early.

sections.title: Time & punctuality
items: The first matches of the day must start on time.
For every match after the first match of the day, warm-up time begins as soon as the previous match on that court ends.
A team that is not present for its warm-up forfeits the first set. If the team does not arrive within 15 minutes, it forfeits the second set and the match.

sections.title: Officials & work teams
items: First referees are provided by the tournament.
Work teams provide 2 line judges, 1 scorekeeper and 1 down official. The down official must be a coach or a very capable player.
Libero tracker and book are not provided. If you want them, please bring your own.

sections.title: Rosters & eligibility
items: Rosters are due to the tournament directors by July 1.
Maximum 14 players and 2 coaches per team.
The tournament is reserved for players who are eligible for the upcoming fall high school season.
NFHS uniform rules do not apply, but players on a team must match and wear numbers that match the roster.

sections.title: Rules of play
items: Current-season NFHS volleyball rules apply unless this page says otherwise.
NFHS volleyball rules and resources ↗

sections.title: Tie-breakers
items: Two teams tied: 1) head-to-head result, 2) set percentage, 3) point percentage, 4) coin flip.

Three or more teams tied: 1) set percentage among all matches, 2) point percentage. Once the tie is down to two teams, use the two-team procedure. If teams are still tied, the lowest seeds flip first.

sections.title: Conduct & spectators
items: Poor conduct, including repeated arguing of calls, foul language, verbal abuse or physical abuse, will not be tolerated. It can result in loss of a set, loss of a match or ejection from the tournament.
These rules apply to players, coaches, parents and spectators.
Spectators of all ages must stay in the court areas in use and may not wander into or play in other spaces.

sections.title: Payment & refunds
items: Entry is $500 per team. On-site lodging is $300 per team.
A non-refundable $150 team deposit is due within 2 weeks of receiving your invoice to secure your spot. The lodging deposit is $100, also non-refundable.
Full payment is due June 1.
Teams that drop on or after June 1 are not eligible for any refund.
Pay by check to PNW SVC with the memo PNW SVC 2027. An official quote or invoice is available on request for school POs.

sections.title: On-site lodging
items: Sleepover style, and the best team-bonding night of the summer. Teams get space in the back gym attached to the venue.
Bring air mattresses, cots and sleeping bags. Showers and bathrooms are provided.
